title: Mini Cloud Set Baked Setting & Smoothing Talc-Free Vegan Powder
descriptionHtml:
✓ Natural Finish✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Best for Oily, Combo, Normal Skin✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Good for: Pores

What it is: A super-soft, sheer setting and smoothing talc-free powder baked with skincare that sweeps away shine (not glow)—now in brightening shades.


Coverage: Light


Formulation: Pressed Powder


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Bamboo Stem Extract: Balances excess oil, leaving skin soft and fresh.

- Passionfruit Leaf Extract: Smooths fine lines and wrinkles.

- Chinese Peony: Visibly minimizes pores.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply Cloud Set (in your skin-tone match) with the Kosas Powder Brush or Face Detailer Brush (sold separately).
-Sweep or pat onto forehead, chin, and nose, or wherever you need to blur, sweep away shine, or set makeup.
-Apply Cloud Set Brightening with Kosas Face Detailer Brush on targeted areas to brighten (under eyes and around mouth and chin).
-Use finger puff if you’d like more coverage.
Ingredients+
-Bamboo Stem Extract: Balances excess oil, leaving skin soft and fresh.
-Passionfruit Leaf Extract: Smooths fine lines and wrinkles.
-Chinese Peony: Visibly minimizes pores.

Mica, Silica, Capryloyl Glycerin/Sebacic Acid Copolymer, Lauroyl Lysine, Glyceryl Stearate, Octyldodecanol, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Pentylene Glycol, Glycerin, Glyceryl Caprylate, Potassium Sorbate, Bambusa Arundinacea Stem Powder, Passiflora Edulis Seed Oil, Glyceryl Undecylenate, Aqua/Water/Eau, Stearic Acid, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Cire de Candelilla, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Phytate, Cetearyl Olivate, Tocopherol, Sorbitan Olivate, Honokiol, Paeonia Officinalis Flower Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Extract, Sodium Benzoate [+/ -: CI 77492, CI 77491 (Iron Oxides), CI 45410 (Red 28), CI 19140 (Yellow 5)].
